upcoming.title: Upcoming features
upcoming.description: Ideas planned for future updates. These items may change as development progresses.

new: Add more filters for storage and file scans
Add a detailed cleaning report with before-and-after totals
improved: Make large scans easier to monitor with clearer progress details
Add more customization options for the dashboard
general: Continue refining accessibility and small-screen layouts

v2.1.0.description: A better cleaning experience with new tools, performance improvements, and important fixes.

new: Added a new storage analysis screen
Added support for exporting cleaning reports
Added a confirmation dialog before deleting app groups
fixes: Fixed incorrect storage calculations
Fixed a crash when opening the cleaner without storage permission
Fixed an issue with app icons not loading correctly
Fixed incorrect file counts during duplicate detection
Fixed a layout issue on smaller screens
Fixed an issue where cancelled scans continued running
Fixed incorrect progress values during cache scanning
Fixed an issue with refreshing the application list
general: Improved error messages during file scanning
Optimized memory usage during large scans
security: Improved validation of file operation requests
Added additional checks before destructive operations

v2.0.0.description: A major update introducing a refreshed interface and several new cleaning tools.

new: Added support for selecting multiple files
fixes: Fixed incorrect storage usage on newer Android versions
Fixed a crash when scanning empty folders
Fixed an issue with selecting files from external storage
Fixed an issue where the back button closed the wrong screen
Fixed a progress indicator that remained visible after scanning
Fixed incorrect sorting of file sizes
general: Improved compatibility with supported Android versions

v1.9.0.description: Improved storage scanning reliability and introduced additional file management tools.

new: Added a recent cleaning activity list
Added an option to exclude selected folders
Added support for refreshing scan results
fixes: Fixed a crash when accessing restricted folders
Fixed incorrect cache size calculations
Fixed an issue with file selection after scanning
Fixed a dialog that remained open after cancelling an operation
Fixed an issue with refreshing storage information
performance: Optimized file scanning for large storage volumes
Reduced memory consumption during duplicate detection

v1.5.0.description: Introduced the initial set of storage scanning and cleaning tools.

new: Added the first storage scanning tool
Added support for scanning internal storage
Added a basic cleaning results screen
Added an option to cancel an active scan
fixes: Fixed a crash when storage permission was denied
Fixed incorrect scan progress
Fixed an issue with returning to the dashboard during scanning

v1.0.0.description: The first release of Cleaner Royall.

new: Added a simple file scanning feature
fixes: Fixed initial dashboard loading
Fixed an issue with displaying storage information
general: Added basic Android storage permission handling
